scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.seed:sample: node scripts/seed.mjs seed/sample.json > seed/sample.sql && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file seed/sample.sql
scripts.seed:tasks: node scripts/seed.mjs seed/tasks.json > seed/tasks.sql && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file seed/tasks.sql
